observed_patterns_used: cards elevadas, testimonials y navegación sticky/fixed
variables CSS de color y tipografía similares al sistema Gravity
source_analysis.contrast_policy: AA/AAA-first: body text 7:1 target, CTA text >= 4.5:1

contrast_report.wcag_note: Valores >= 4.5 son AA para texto normal; bg_text apunta a >= 7 cuando el palette lo permite.

design_system_injection.custom_css: :root { --bg: #FAFAF7; --surface: #FFFFFF; --surface-alt: #EEF0E9; --text: #13231D; --muted: #4B5F56; --primary: #047857; --accent: #B45309; --on-primary: #FFFFFF; --on-accent: #FFFFFF; --border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 14%, transparent); --grid-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 8%, transparent); --radius: 32px; --gap: 20px; --blur: 16px; --nav-position: sticky; --shadow: 0 24px 70px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 13%, transparent); --shadow-strong: 0 36px 100px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 20%, transparent); } body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; } h1,h2,h3,.display { font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; } .testimonial-card { padding: 28px; border-radius: var(--radius); background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--surface), color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 92%, var(--primary))); border: 1px solid var(--border); } .testimonial-card__stars { color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: .16em; } .avatar { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); } body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background-image: radial-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 18%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 4px 4px; opacity: .035; z-index: 80; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .hero, .hero--bento, .local-map-panel, .editorial-flow { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; } .proof-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
